citations.locator: Vol. 4, § 69, Progress and Completion of the Schism. Cerularius
citations.excerpt: Finally, on the 16th of July, 1054, they excommunicated the patriarch and all those who should persistently censure the faith of the church of Rome
The dispute which led to the separation of the Latin and Greek Churches is known as the “Great Schism,”

facts.value: Papal legates excommunicated Patriarch Michael Cerularius of Constantinople. The dispute that led to the separation of the Latin and Greek churches is known as the Great Schism.
